text:
ana: reconcile-bot flagged config drift between prod and staging for gpu-nodepool in cluster 'redwood-inference-prod' — bot says it's high priority
reconcile-bot: [ALERT] drift-scan detected 3 diffs: (1) nodepool.gpu_count mismatch (prod: 64, repo: 48) (2) autoscaler.min differs (prod: 5, repo: 2) (3) helm values: values.gpu.enabled=true in prod release but false in repo
shawn: ugh, I noticed extra GPU nodes last night, wondered why. anyone manually resized?
maya: we did a quick resize as a hotfix last week to relieve OOMs in a tenant job — didn't push repo change, that was me (sorry)
leo: audit logs show user 'infra-oncall' performed a resize at 2026-01-22T03:12Z (nodepool size 48 -> 64)
ana: thanks — reconcile-bot suggests auto-remediating by pushing repo -> prod or prod -> repo. we should not drift the repo to match prod.
shawn: agreed. we need to capture the manual change as a PR so gitops is the single source of truth. don't auto-apply prod state as config.
maya: proposed steps: 1) snapshot prod infra state `terraform state pull > prod.tfstate.backup` 2) open infra PR that updates desired nodepool/gpu_count to 64 with justification and cost note 3) run a canary gitops sync to verify no regressions
leo: note: shrinking or changing node counts can evict pods. If we change the repo to 64 (to match prod) that's safe; if we later reduce, do during maintenance. Also check region GPU quota before any further scaling.
ana: terraform plan snippet from prod drift check:
```
~ google_container_node_pool.gpu_pool
    node_count: 48 -> 64
```
shawn: cost FYI: +16 GPUs ~= $X/hr (~$Y/day). include that in PR description and tag finance for visibility.
maya: helm mismatch looks like someone patched the ArgoCD app to flip `values.gpu.enabled` on prod. we should revert the app patch and put the change in git.
leo: for quotas run: `gcloud compute regions describe us-west1 --project=redwood-prod` — last read showed GPU quota at ~92% so be careful if we try to increase in other regions too.
ana: reconcile-bot proposed action: auto_remediate=false, advise manual PR. I'll open the PR now and include the diff and backup state.
reconcile-bot: created ticket infra#452 with suggested reconciliation steps (auto_remediate=false)
shawn: also add `terraform import` notes in the PR if resources were created out-of-band so state stays consistent.
maya: pinging oncall for a short maintenance window for any nodepool ops @oncall
oncall: acknowledging, requesting 60m window tomorrow 10:00-11:00 UTC.
leo: plan of record: 1) capture prod state and create PR that aligns repo -> prod (so gitops won't try to revert immediately) 2) schedule canary sync and monitor pod evictions and GPU utilization 3) follow-up to remove the manual override and adopt autoscaler tuning so min/max reflect steady state
ana: I'll draft the PR and include cost calc, audit trail, and runbook link: https://go.redwood/runbooks/infra/reconcile-gpu
infra-ci (deploy-bot): canary gitops sync scheduled 2026-02-01T10:00Z for infra-pr-###
shawn: LGTM, will review the PR and verify terraform plan.
maya: thanks — once PR merges we should re-run reconcile-scan and mark infra#452 resolved.
leo: prefer manual reconciliation rather than auto-apply for this one. :thumbsup:
ana: closing loop for now, will update thread when PR is open/merged and when reconcile-scan clears.
reconcile-bot: next scan scheduled in 1h.
